name: Chemical Engineering Summer Program
what_you_do: A four-day program that introduces chemical engineering. You do hands-on labs and team challenges. You meet faculty and alumni and tour labs. You also learn about college applications and aid.
grades: Students currently in 10th or 11th grade (rising juniors and seniors)
who_can_apply: Students currently enrolled in 10th or 11th grade. Not residential.
pay_detail: $400 if you register before June 1 and $450 before July 1. The fee includes a light breakfast each day and a T-shirt. Finishers get a certificate and a $75 application fee waiver for the chemical engineering degree.
duration: 4 days, July 19 to 22, 2027, 9 AM to 3 PM each day
deadline_text: Early registration is $400 before June 1 and $450 before July 1. The page does not give a final cutoff and says the program has filled up before. The registration form could not be read by this check.
how_to_apply: Step 1: fill out the Program Registration Form. Step 2: pay with the Program Payment Form. Both steps are needed to confirm a spot. The contact is listed on the page.
notes: The page says to register early because the program has hit its limit in past years. Confirm that registration is open before you plan around it.
